title: Between Stillness and Light
meta: Output: Diasec Print (Plexiglas + Alucobond), Fine Art Print (Hahnemühle Photo Rag / German Etching), Custom Archival on request
Framing: Diasec ready-to-hang with aluminum backing; fine art prints shipped rolled
statement: Suspended between breath and disappearance, a face emerges from the quiet haze — neither solid nor dissolving, simply present. The cracks on the surface whisper of transformation: fragility becoming openness, silence turning luminous. Light drifts through stillness like memory through skin — a reminder that even in stillness, everything moves.
